haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes unless claimed. Then Inventory's expiry timer marks it EXPIRED and the stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Stock is reserved before the charge is requested. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing, returns short items, and Order sets REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK.
haiku-low.q3: The charge uses the order id as Idempotency-Key, and the charge row is unique on order id. The provider returns the same result for that key.
haiku-low.q4: Order sets CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, publishes RefundRequested, and emails the customer. Payment refunds the full amount. The cart stays the same.
haiku-low.q5: Only when Cart receives OrderConfirmed, after the claim is accepted. If checkout fails for any reason, the cart stays exactly as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service runs the saga. Its database records the order status, status history, pending release and claim calls, and saved payment outcomes.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which verifies it, logs it, and writes an outbox event. The relay publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined, which Order consumes.
haiku-low.q8: Payment's webhook log rejects repeated provider event ids. Consumers ignore repeats by event id, and Order ignores events for orders already in a final state.
haiku-low.q9: Payment publishes PaymentDeclined. Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED and asks Inventory to release the reservation at once, without waiting for the timer.
haiku-low.q10: Inventory's claim decides. If accepted, the order is CONFIRMED. If refused because the hold is EXPIRED or RELEASED, the order is CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and refunded.
haiku-low.q11: The refund row stays open and retries with backoff, never deleted. After the attempt limit it becomes FAILED_NEEDS_ATTENTION. The limit is NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q12: Order's OrderConfirmed event, sent after a successful claim. The Cart service receives it and empties that cart.

sonnet.q1: Held 10 minutes (expires_at = now + 10 min). If not claimed, Inventory's expiry timer marks it EXPIRED and the stock goes back on sale; Order sets a hold_expired flag and keeps waiting.
sonnet.q2: Reserved before charging. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing (all-or-nothing) and returns the short items; Order sets REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, shows the items, requests no payment, cart unchanged.
sonnet.q3: Payment retries the provider call with the same Idempotency-Key (the order id), so the provider returns the same result. The charge row is also unique on order id.
sonnet.q4: The claim is refused, so Order sets CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK, publishes RefundRequested and emails the customer. Payment refunds the full amount. Stock is not given to this order; cart unchanged.
sonnet.q5: The cart is emptied only on OrderConfirmed. If checkout fails for any reason the cart stays exactly as it was.
sonnet.q6: The Order service runs the saga and moves steps (background worker, recovery job). Progress is recorded in Order's own database: order status, status history, pending release/claim calls, and saved payment outcomes.
sonnet.q7: The provider sends a signed webhook to Payment. Payment verifies it, records the charge outcome and writes an outbox event in one transaction; the relay publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined on the broker, which Order consumes. If no webhook comes within 45 minutes, Payment polls the provider.
sonnet.q8: Payment keeps a webhook log of provider event ids; a repeat returns 200 and changes nothing. Consumers ignore repeats by event id, and Order ignores events for orders already in a final state. A charge is set only once.
sonnet.q9: Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED on receiving the PaymentDeclined event and asks Inventory to release the reservation at once (HELD to RELEASED), putting stock back on sale. If release never succeeds, the hold expires after 10 minutes anyway.
sonnet.q10: Order asks Inventory to claim; the claim is a conditional update that works only if the reservation is still HELD and not past expires_at. If accepted, the order is CONFIRMED; if refused (EXPIRED or RELEASED), the order is cancelled and the full amount refunded.
sonnet.q11: The refund row stays open (never deleted) and retries with backoff. After the attempt limit it becomes FAILED_NEEDS_ATTENTION, ops are paged, and retries continue. A daily reconciliation compares provider refunds with open rows. It is tracked in Payment's refund row (PENDING, unique on order id, written before the provider call). The limit and backoff schedule are not set.
sonnet.q12: Order publishes OrderConfirmed to its outbox when the claim is accepted; the Cart service empties the cart on that event.
